scripts.build: npm run build -w @alken/api && npm run build -w @alken/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @alken/api && npm run typecheck -w @alken/web
scripts.deploy: git pull && docker compose build && docker compose up -d --force-recreate && docker image prune -f
scripts.deploy:fresh: git pull && docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
